component.culprit: no CAPCLI_SECRET_* environment variables present in process scope
component.remedy: Set CAPCLI_SECRET_<NAME> in the harness shell and re-run `capcli sys vault import-env`; or provision the value directly with `capcli sys vault set <key> <value>`. Imported values land in the encrypted vault with SHA-256 fingerprints; plaintext zeroized after ingest.
